programs.title: Gi Jiu Jitsu Adult (14 +)
programs.description: Build a strong Brazilian jiu-jitsu base with structured drills, positional rounds, and live sparring. Learn to blend fluid transitions with smart strategy on the mats.
highlights: Live sparring to apply new skills
Coaching tailored to every experience level

programs.title: Kids Jiu Jitsu
programs.description: Boost confidence, discipline, and coordination through playful technique. Classes focus on practical self-defence while keeping training upbeat and supportive.

programs.title: No Gi Jiu Jitsu (14 +)
programs.description: Level up grappling without the gi by combining BJJ, wrestling, and submission fundamentals. Ideal for MMA cross-training and athletes who like a faster pace.
highlights: Blend BJJ, wrestling, and submission grappling
Fast-paced rounds for MMA crossover training

programs.title: Kickboxing (14 +)
programs.description: Sharpen striking technique with Dutch-style pad work, bag drills, and conditioning. Classes welcome every fitness level and deliver a serious sweat.

programs.title: Randori
programs.description: Open mat style rolling to test new techniques or drill with teammates. Stay playful, experiment, and build mat time in a coached environment.
